what: Live end-to-end proof of the F1 frontier redesign (marginal Delta_i/SigmaDelta_j crediting) on Base Sepolia (chainId 84532). Two solvers on one pool: A lands a big improvement (seed 6e18 -> score 1e18); B free-rides a tiny marginal step (1e18 -> 0.9e18). Proves B is credited ONLY its marginal (0.1e18), not the seed-relative distance the old design paid -- closing the free-rider exploit that was audit finding F1.

free_rider_contrast.note: Under the audited (broken) design B would have captured ~half the pool for a marginal step because credit = seed - score, summed with no live frontier. Under F1 (credit = previous_best - score), B earns only its true marginal Delta.

indexer.note: The indexer decoded the NEW Finalized event ABI (creditAtoms/claimedScoreAtoms/bestScoreAtoms) and rebuilt the frontier (2 finalized) + payout ledger (A 98.03% / B 1.96%, totalCreditAtoms 5.1e18) purely from chain events, matching the contract views 12/12.

summary: F1 marginal crediting is correct on live Base Sepolia: the on-chain frontier advances monotonically, credit is the marginal reduction, the pool split equals Delta_i/SigmaDelta_j, and the free-rider's capture drops from ~50% (old) to ~2% (its true marginal). The full new-ABI stack (solver score-encoding -> contract -> ledger -> indexer reconstruction) verified end-to-end.
